from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path.cwd()
EVIDENCE = ROOT / "work/ceres-v3/05/evidence/controlled-20261005T213814Z-e9eee78c"
BASELINE = json.loads((EVIDENCE / "baseline-intake.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
OLD_MAP = json.loads((EVIDENCE / "core-001/case-node-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
OLD_ENV = json.loads((EVIDENCE / "core-001/environment.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
PYTHON = ROOT / "backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
DB = ROOT / "data/sale_guide.db"
ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_PATHS = {
    "backend/app/agent/authorization.py",
    "backend/app/agent/protocol.py",
    "backend/app/schemas/goal.py",
}
CASE_MAP = {row["case_id"]: row["actual_collected_execution_nodes"] for row in OLD_MAP["case_results"]}
CORE_NODES = OLD_MAP["actual_collected_nodes"]
PAIR_NODES = [CASE_MAP["R01"][0], CASE_MAP["R08"][0]]
DIRECT_GOAL_PROTOCOL_NODES = [
    "tests/test_goal_understanding.py::test_explicit_product_purchase_is_ready",
    "tests/test_goal_decision_gate.py::test_a_product_purchase_never_asks_about_people",
]


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def source_hashes() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {entry["path"]: sha(ROOT / entry["path"]) for entry in BASELINE["current_worktree_checks"]}


def dump(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


run_dir = EVIDENCE / "core-002"
if run_dir.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing evidence: {run_dir}")
run_dir.mkdir()
before = source_hashes()
baseline_checks = {entry["path"]: entry["expected_sha256"] for entry in BASELINE["current_worktree_checks"]}
changed = {path for path, value in before.items() if value != baseline_checks[path]}
if changed != ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_PATHS:
    raise SystemExit(f"candidate source scope mismatch: {sorted(changed)}")
if len(before) != 304 or sha(DB) != BASELINE["source_catalog"]["sha256_expected"]:
    raise SystemExit("frozen 304-path/catalog precondition failed")
dump(run_dir / "candidate-source-freeze.json", {
    "frozen_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "baseline_commit": BASELINE["git_head_actual"],
    "baseline_source_zip_sha256": BASELINE["source_zip_sha256_actual"],
    "baseline_manifest_count": len(before),
    "baseline_catalog_sha256": sha(DB),
    "allowed_candidate_paths": sorted(ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_PATHS),
    "candidate_changed_paths": sorted(changed),
    "all_candidate_hashes": before,
    "all_other_301_match_baseline": all(before[path] == baseline_checks[path] for path in before if path not in ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_PATHS),
})

base_env = OLD_ENV["controlled_values"].copy()
plugin_root = str(EVIDENCE / "core-001")


def run_phase(name: str, nodes: list[str]) -> dict:
    phase = run_dir / name
    phase.mkdir()
    (phase / "os-temp").mkdir()
    pytest_base = phase / "pytest-basetemp"
    junit = phase / "junit.xml"
    trace = phase / "trace.jsonl"
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for key in list(env):
        upper = key.upper()
        if upper.startswith(("OPENAI_", "ANTHROPIC_", "AZURE_", "GEMINI_", "DEEPSEEK_", "DASHSCOPE_", "QWEN_", "KEV_", "MEMORY_", "EMBEDDING_", "RETRIEVAL_", "MERCURY_", "LLM_")) or upper in {
            "DATABASE_URL", "SOURCE_DATABASE_PATH", "TEMP", "TMP", "TMPDIR", "PYTHONPATH", "HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "NO_PROXY"
        }:
            del env[key]
    controlled = base_env.copy()
    controlled.update({
        "MERCURY_DB_PATH": str(phase / "mercury.sqlite3"),
        "DATABASE_URL": f"sqlite:///{phase / 'unused-default.sqlite3'}",
        "SOURCE_DATABASE_PATH": str(DB),
        "TEMP": str(phase / "os-temp"),
        "TMP": str(phase / "os-temp"),
        "TMPDIR": str(phase / "os-temp"),
        "PYTHONPATH": plugin_root,
        "CERES_TRACE_PATH": str(trace),
    })
    env.update(controlled)
    argv = [
        str(PYTHON), "-X", "utf8", "-m", "pytest", "-vv", "--showlocals",
        "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-W", "error::pytest.PytestUnhandledThreadExceptionWarning",
        "-p", "ceres_controlled_trace", f"--basetemp={pytest_base}", f"--junitxml={junit}", *nodes,
    ]
    (phase / "command.txt").write_text(subprocess.list2cmdline(argv) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    dump(phase / "command.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(BACKEND), "transport": "subprocess argv, no shell"})
    dump(phase / "environment.json", {
        "controlled_values": controlled,
        "actual_python": str(PYTHON),
        "python_version": "3.12.10",
        "pytest_version": "9.1.1",
        "network_boundary": "loopback port 9, fixtures control model/network calls, proxies cleared",
        "retrieval": "RETRIEVAL_INDEX_DIR empty; ordinary client direct DB; indexed_client pairs lexical index with each test DB",
    })
    phase_before = source_hashes()
    dump(phase / "source-before.json", {
        "hashes": phase_before,
        "matches_candidate_freeze": phase_before == before,
        "catalog_sha256": sha(DB),
    })
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (phase / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (phase / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=BACKEND, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False)
    duration = time.monotonic() - started
    phase_after = source_hashes()
    parsed = []
    junit_error = None
    try:
        root = ET.parse(junit).getroot()
        for item in root.iter("testcase"):
            outcome = "passed"
            detail = None
            for child in item:
                if child.tag in {"failure", "error"}:
                    outcome = child.tag
                    detail = {"message": child.attrib.get("message"), "text": child.text}
                elif child.tag == "skipped":
                    outcome = "skipped"
            parsed.append({"classname": item.attrib.get("classname"), "name": item.attrib.get("name"), "outcome": outcome, "failure": detail})
    except Exception as exc:
        junit_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    trace_records = [json.loads(line) for line in trace.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()] if trace.exists() else []
    dump(phase / "source-after.json", {
        "hashes": phase_after,
        "matches-phase-before": phase_after == phase_before,
        "matches-candidate-freeze": phase_after == before,
        "catalog_sha256": sha(DB),
    })
    dump(phase / "junit-summary.json", {"cases": parsed, "parse_error": junit_error})
    dump(phase / "result.json", {
        "exit_code": result.returncode,
        "duration_seconds": duration,
        "selected_node_count": len(nodes),
        "junit_node_count": len(parsed),
        "passed": sum(item["outcome"] == "passed" for item in parsed),
        "failed_or_error": [item for item in parsed if item["outcome"] in {"failure", "error"}],
        "trace_record_count": len(trace_records),
        "sse_trace_count": sum(item.get("kind") == "sse_events" for item in trace_records),
        "stdout_sha256": sha(phase / "stdout.txt"),
        "stderr_sha256": sha(phase / "stderr.txt"),
        "source_unchanged": phase_before == phase_after == before,
    })
    return json.loads((phase / "result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


dump(run_dir / "requested-node-map.json", {
    "focused_quantity_nodes": PAIR_NODES,
    "full_original_core_nodes": CORE_NODES,
    "direct_goal_protocol_regressions": DIRECT_GOAL_PROTOCOL_NODES,
    "focused_phase_order": "R01+R08 first; full regression proceeds only if both pass",
})
pair_result = run_phase("phase-001-r01-r08", PAIR_NODES)
full_result = None
if pair_result["exit_code"] == 0 and pair_result["junit_node_count"] == 2:
    full_result = run_phase("phase-002-core16-goal-protocol", CORE_NODES + DIRECT_GOAL_PROTOCOL_NODES)

after = source_hashes()
summary = {
    "completed_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "run_dir": str(run_dir.relative_to(ROOT)),
    "candidate_source_unchanged_through_runs": after == before,
    "candidate_hashes_after": after,
    "allowed_candidate_paths": sorted(ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_PATHS),
    "all_other_301_still_match_frozen_baseline": all(after[path] == baseline_checks[path] for path in after if path not in ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_PATHS),
    "phase_001": pair_result,
    "phase_002": full_result,
    "phase_002_skipped_reason": None if full_result else "focused R01/R08 gate did not exit zero with exactly two JUnit nodes",
}
dump(run_dir / "summary.json", summary)
print(json.dumps({
    "evidence_dir": str(run_dir),
    "phase_001_exit": pair_result["exit_code"],
    "phase_001_nodes": pair_result["junit_node_count"],
    "phase_002_exit": full_result["exit_code"] if full_result else None,
    "phase_002_nodes": full_result["junit_node_count"] if full_result else None,
    "candidate_source_unchanged": after == before,
}, ensure_ascii=False))
sys.exit(0)
